title: Astral experience on 'the hill' after Zoom call with a Telepathy Tapes guest, linked through Ken from Baker Victory

tellings.quote: they were showing me an image of um, a kid named Ken that was in the program that I was in at Baker Victory who was a non-verbal autistic

plain: After a video call with a guest from The Telepathy Tapes, a podcast about non-speaking autistic people said to communicate by telepathy, Jordan Jose had an out-of-body experience in a place he calls 'the hill.' Jose, who says he was taken into a UFO program as a child, tells it himself: there, "they" showed him an image of a boy named Ken, a non-verbal autistic child who had been with him in a children's program called Baker Victory. To Jose this tied the telepathy story to his own childhood.
